items.item: Event bus + durable task queue + resource-aware workers + artifact store + dependency DAG
evidence: libs/ops/events.py — append-only event log with a declared vocabulary (KINDS), LEG_EVENT domain transitions, since()/latest()/census() bounded tail readers (MEASURED)

libs/ops/task_queue.py — an append-only journal folded into state, LEASES rather than locks (a worker that dies returns its task when the lease expires, without anyone noticing the death), bounded attempts so a poison task goes DEAD instead of round the loop forever, and dedupe against LIVE work only (MEASURED)
libs/ops/task_queue.py — subscribe(event_kind, task_kind) plus a durable watermark: an EVENT queues work, once, however many times the log is drained. That is I2's first gap in one call (MEASURED)

tests/ops/test_task_queue.py — 20 cases including a torn line from a crash costing that transition and not the queue, a corrupt lease reading as expired rather than as a permanent lock, and a burst of one event queueing one task (MEASURED)
items.consumer: research_queue -> external_gauntlet/merge_hypotheses/build_zentech_state; manifest_dispatch_state.json -> NONE (self-documented at scripts/run_manifest_dispatch.py:65-67); compute_ledger -> libs/research/... none joins it (MODEL_ZOO.json reports '0 usable run(s)')
items.gap: The queue is durable and events can trigger work, but NOTHING CLAIMS FROM IT YET: no leg calls claim(), so the hourly cycle still runs in source order and the queue is a capability the desk owns and does not use. By this desk's vocabulary that is EXISTS-DARK inside a PARTIAL row, and it is deliberately not scheduled here -- an hourly drain whose queue no worker reads is what check_dead_architecture calls BURNING. The worker pool proper is I3 and is gated on hardware this desk lacks.
items.next_step: One consumer, and the row goes LIT. Have hourly_cycle drain events into the queue in its `health` leg and have ONE existing leg (recertify_canon is the natural first, since CERTIFICATE_MINTED is already emitted) claim its work from the queue instead of running unconditionally. That single change is what turns a cycle that runs in source order into one that runs because something happened.

items.consumer: external_gauntlet / run_external_backtest read the parquet panels; PIT_CENSUS -> pit_high_water ratchet -> CI gate
items.gap: Coverage itself is still low: raising the stamped fraction means moving each producer onto libs.data.pit.stamp, which is per-miner plumbing on the box. bronze/silver/gold now EXISTS as a row property with a refusing promoter, but no producer writes through it yet and no clock runs a promotion, so the ladder is built and unused. AND A NAMED EXPOSURE, measured 2026-09-09 and left alone deliberately: `libs.data.pit.AVAILABLE_KEYS` lists `published_at`, so a row carrying one is available from the moment it was PUBLISHED rather than from the moment this desk ingested it -- right for a feed the desk subscribes to, lookahead for a source it scrapes weeks later, and no field on the row tells the two apart. Narrowing that constant decides what EVERY backtest may read, so it is the principal's call and not an autonomous one.
items.next_step: Two, in order. (1) Point one producer at lake.promote: desks/mt5/side_channels/seed_miners.py already writes rows, so writing them as BRONZE and running a bronze->silver promotion on the hourly leg turns the ladder from built into used and publishes its refusal count. (2) Put the available_time question to the principal: either split AVAILABLE_KEYS by source kind (subscribed feed vs scrape) or drop `published_at` from it and let ingestion be the availability everywhere.

items.note: CLOSED UPWARD ONLY, AND NOW UNIVERSAL ACROSS THE BRACKET AND FAMILY LANES. Routing gold at h_i ALONE would be a size CUT at today's equity on the desk's only forward-evidenced book, so the sent lot is max(allocator, policy, floor): the semantic break is gone and the size can only rise. THE HEAT IDENTITY IS EXACT AND NOT APPROXIMATE. Round 2 made charge and send call one sizer; they still called it with different arguments (house nominal stop before the cap, real bracket stop at the venue), and because realised_q is LINEAR IN THE STOP the 0.02 floor could make both return the identical lot while the leg ran several times the fraction reserved -- 5.78x measured. Round 3 found three ways it was still not a universal statement: a pre-cap failure could become a send later in the same pass, the same defect lived one lane over in auto_ramp's ramped_fraction charge, and the cancel hour was checked only at the send so the cap could reserve budget for an order that could never go out. All three are closed structurally. Nothing was shrunk, capped or vetoed: the only refusal added is 'not priced before the cap, so not sent in this pass', which costs no size because the next pass prices it first, and the zero charge for an unplaceable sleeve FREES budget for sleeves that can trade. ROUND 4 CLOSED THE SCALP LANE. It was the one lane still billed a requested fraction, and it needed a refactor rather than an extraction: the executor interleaved the entry decision with live basket state. Every lane that sends an order now resolves and prices it before the cap; the `from_book` fraction branch is reached by no sending lane at all.

tests/research/test_information_flow.py — 16 cases against known ground truth: the Miller-Madow correction removes the plug-in bias (corrected mean |0.004| nats on independent data against a positive plug-in mean), negatives are returned not clamped, conditioning collapses a pure shared driver to under 15% of its MI while sparing a mechanism, TE is directed >5x, TE IS the CMI on lagged blocks, and the free-shuffle null is measurably anti-conservative against the circular shift (MEASURED)
tests/research/test_causal_graph.py — the reading is an ANNOTATION: status, reason, strength and incremental_info are identical with it removed (MEASURED)

libs/research/causal_graph.py — conditional_information_flow(): nonlinear I(X;Y | Z, Y's own past) on the SAME aligned sample and lags as the deltaR2 beside it, published on evidence['conditional_information_flow'] of every conditioned edge (MEASURED, external audit round 3)

tests/research/test_causal_graph.py — MEASURED 2026-09-09 on a planted shared driver: conditioning leaves 5% of the unconditioned MI (0.0245 of 0.4578 nats), while a genuine mechanism on the same driver keeps 23% (0.1771 of 0.7754) and is ~7x the driver's CMI; both return p=0.005, so again only the magnitude separates them (MEASURED)

tests/research/test_causal_graph.py — the nonlinear conditional REFUSES below its stated floor (1,280 aligned bars for one admitted parent at four bins, against MIN_N=500) rather than answering from too few cells, which is why it annotates the linear test and does not replace it (MEASURED)
items.consumer: desks/mt5/research/state_vector_build.py:335 world_conditioning → StateVector.conditioning; libs/research/search_populations.causal_derived; miner_candidate_compiler (anomalies)
items.note: DEMOTED 2026-09-09 on an external audit that was right, and closed the same day. The audit's finding was exact: Granger-style incremental information, lagged cross-correlation, state dependence and bootstrap/permutation machinery all existed, and every one of them is LINEAR OR MONOTONE, while a grep for transfer entropy or conditional mutual information across libs/ and desks/ returned one hit -- a field NAME in alpha_recombination.py with no implementation behind it. Both estimators now exist, are tested against generators whose answer is known before they run, and are read on every edge the hourly leg measures. They admit nothing: the admission rule is the deflated interval plus the incremental test, and a second gate here would change what the graph admits without anyone deciding to. The honest limit is stated in the module and pinned by a test: the p-value does NOT separate a mechanism from a shared driver -- both return p=0.005 under the within-Z null -- only the magnitude against the unconditioned MI does. ROUND 3 ADDED THE CONFOUNDER-AWARE HALF. Transfer entropy conditions on the TARGET'S OWN history; the audit was right that the target's other admitted parents were still handled only by the regression-based conditional_information. Nonlinear I(X;Y | other admitted parents of Y) is now computed beside that deltaR2, on the same sample and the same lags, and it is annotation-only exactly as TE is: the conditional STATUS remains the deltaR2's.

items.item: THE FEED/CLOCK/INFORMATION-PROPAGATION OBSERVATORY (LAWS 5m): market data as a sensor network. Five clocks kept apart (source event, exchange stamp, vendor receipt, local receipt, cross-venue implied time -- the last never merged into a receipt), per-instrument receipt latency with negatives kept, stamp continuity (inversions, duplicates; MT5 carries no sequence numbers so drops are a NAMED silence-burst proxy), staleness probability as the feed's own in-session gap survival function, reference consistency of tape mid against H1 close at every whole-hour lag (the best lag IS the venue's measured clock offset), feed_health(now) = P(observed market is trustworthy | all feeds) as a product of component probabilities per feed and a geometric mean across feeds in session with the worst feed published beside it (a closed feed EXCLUDED, never scored 0), a causally admissible propagation graph (an edge a->b at lag L is refused below |offset_a - offset_b| + jitter_a + jitter_b), and the timing-corruption test on every LIVE and STANDBY sleeve's recent signals (jitter, dropped messages, stale quotes, sequence inversions at the instrument's MEASURED noise and at 10x/100x): a sleeve whose edge halves is TIMING_FRAGILE, recorded as a registry discovery and published as candidate_prior `prior:timing_fragile`. Feed health is stamped into data/feed_health.json and onto every admitted sleeve row by decision_core.load_sleeves_verbose as an INPUT for entry timing, never a cap (GROWTH_GOVERNANCE Rule 1).

items.item: THE EXECUTION / MARKET-IMPACT ALPHA LAB (LAWS 5m): from the desk's OWN fill corpus, order intents, live ledger (closed deals as flow, direction from bracket geometry, never the ambiguous side code) and the gateway's retcode lines, joined to its own tape at the order's second -- spread by session, fill probability with Wilson intervals (rejected counted as unfilled), rejection behaviour by reason/session/type, slippage by order type, partial fills, stop behaviour, Kyle-lambda impact (OLS of signed mid change on signed flow normalised per instrument, permutation null on the flow's signs) split permanent (5 min) and transient (5 s minus 5 min), the queue/latency effect (Spearman with a permutation p), session cost curves (half-spread plus slippage) and the toxicity STATE of a fill window (TOXIC/BENIGN/MIXED/UNMEASURED on the Wilson interval of P(adverse markout)). Execution cells per (instrument, session) are recorded as registry discoveries (`execution_cell`) and execution-conditioned candidate seeds are donated to the compiler in the seat shape it reads (data/intelligence/feed_clock_lab/discoveries_<ts>.json). Nothing here sizes, caps or vetoes: an execution cell is a hypothesis for the gauntlet.

items.item: PROBABILITY ENGINES AND THEIR RELIABILITY CURVES (RESEARCH 11, LAWS 5m): six independent probability engines -- P1 macro/statistical, P2 options-implied, P3 prediction market, P4 cross-asset, P5 LLM/news, P6 physical/fundamental -- each CONSUMING an existing organ's report (macro_intelligence/world_model, shadow_institutional's named surfaces, prediction_markets, transmission_engine + driver bars, news_event_stream, the COT/SGE planes) and re-implementing none, mapped onto the MT5 targets (XAUUSD, USDJPY, EURUSD, US500/NAS100, XTIUSD/XBRUSD, USDX, UST10Y and the hunt universe by universe_policy) at 1h/4h/1d/5d. Each engine has a reliability curve per regime (binned + isotonic with n and a minimum-n UNMEASURED rule) measured on history under the anti-lookahead rule (a forecast is usable only after its available_time; leaked forecasts are withheld and counted), consensus/dispersion/lead/anomaly measures, and a forward forecast ledger for the engines that cannot be replayed. An engine with no surface, no contract or no news probability reads UNMEASURED by name per target, never p = 0.5. Nothing sizes capital.

items.item: THE REALITY-CALIBRATED MARKET DIGITAL TWIN WITH SIMULATION-BASED INFERENCE (LAWS 5m): a compact agent-based tape simulator whose latent world is the participant mix (market makers with inventory preferences, trend followers, mean reverters, dealer hedgers, forced liquidators with finite leveraged pools, retail noise, passive scheduled flow), self-exciting order arrivals, cancellation behaviour, a latency distribution, a concave impact function, intraday seasonality and news jumps -- producing bars, spreads, ranges, volumes, signed flow, depth and a cancellation proxy; 37 summary statistics of a real tape window (return moments, autocorrelations at four lags, tails and jump frequency, volatility clustering, spread and range distributions, volume clustering, a depth proxy, signed-flow impact where sided quotes exist, quote flicker, intraday seasonality, state-conditioned responses; NaN = UNMEASURED); ABC-SMC with a learned (semi-automatic ridge-projection) summary distance over a scrambled-Sobol pilot giving a weighted particle POSTERIOR over worlds; posterior predictive checks group by group with a robust median/MAD discrepancy floored at each statistic's own resolution (a world that reproduces returns and nothing else is RETURNS_ONLY and not realistic; a tape without sided quotes is at most REALISTIC_PARTIAL); a PUBLISHED twin-vs-reality CALIBRATION SCORE (share of measurable statistics reproduced, worst statistic named) per twin and across the universe; the mechanism-plausibility test and PRE-REGISTRATION of the three canonical mechanisms (expected effect per event, its 90% band, events per window, events needed at 80% power). One twin per hunt-universe instrument in rotation (cursor), calibrated from H1/M5 bars and the tick tape where present, worlds per batch DERIVED from measured free memory.

items.item: THE DATA-AS-CODE POINT-IN-TIME CONTRACT LAYER, THE FEATURE GENOME AND THE MULTIMODAL FEATURE COMPILER (LAWS 5m; RESEARCH 11 UniversalCell/DatasetContract; principal 2026-09-22): every dataset carries a DatasetContract with exactly the fourteen fields RESEARCH 11 lists (source, owner, acquisition method, public or licensed, licence version, permitted uses, redistribution rights, personal-data status, MNPI review status, jurisdiction, PIT timestamp, revision policy, retention policy, compliance owner) plus vintage semantics -- immutable content-hashed snapshots, a revision as a successor vintage naming what it supersedes, a schema contract hashed into the lineage, declared timestamp semantics, machine_use_allowed, a freshness lease, first/last availability stamps -- and a content-hashed, parent-linked, code-versioned LineageRecord so any experiment can be replayed (replay_key / verify). validate() names every missing field; admissible() is the LEGALITY HARD GATE (False for BLOCKED provenance, an unresolved MNPI review, a refused access label or an incomplete contract) and takes no value argument, so legality is never traded against profitability. The FEATURE GENOME carries every feature's chain DATA ORIGIN -> PIT normalisation -> entity alignment -> representation -> transform/interaction -> mechanism -> model -> regime -> execution -> portfolio with distances on the six named axes (data-source, representation, mechanism, researcher/search, signal, PnL/tail); orthogonality is HIERARCHICAL -- effective independence = min(PnL reading, lineage reading), so two strategies with 0.1 return correlation and one lineage read as less independent than their PnL -- and lineage_concentration(portfolio) is EVIDENCE the allocator conditions on, never a cap (GROWTH_GOVERNANCE Rule 1). The FEATURE COMPILER types every ingested modality (prices, text claims through polyglot, the shadow/data-plane sensors, calendars, rule states, positioning, macro releases, the forge's representations) into contracted, lineage-hashed representations with a genome, routes every new field discover -> PIT archive -> semantics -> entity mapping -> representation forge -> world model / candidates / interactions, and compiles EVERY INGESTED UNIT (through the ingestion ledger's own collector) to a typed feature with lineage and a contract state; a dataset without a contract is a CONTRACT_MISSING DEFECT ROW that the ingestion ledger publishes on every pass and that never brakes mining. The genome is consumed through guarded hooks by the representation forge (on every minted record, manifest row and donation) and by the candidate compiler (lineage_json on the candidate).

items.item: THE ACTIVE DATA-ACQUISITION SCIENTIST (LAWS 5m; RESEARCH 11; principal 2026-09-22): decides WHICH missing dataset has the highest expected research value, EV = P(independent forward survivor) x expected information gain x independence / (data cost + compute + engineering) x 1[legally permitted], reading the coverage tensor's frontier holes (EVIG and judged-neighbour survival rates), the residual hunt's open targets (effect sizes), the missed-trade parents when that organ publishes them, the country packs' datasets DECLARED ABSENT and the data scout's needs; merges them by dataset, measures redundancy against what the desk already holds, prices each off the scout's catalogue where a route is declared, and writes a DatasetContract for every request. Legality is the HARD GATE: an inadmissible contract is EV 0 at any value -- ACQUIRE (fetch, sample, use) needs the full contract admitted, a SOURCE_HUNT task (ask the scouts to locate a lawful public source) needs only that the dataset is not BLOCKED -- and a page whose terms forbid machine extraction is registered and never fetched. For the top admissible candidates with a public URL route it builds a small lawful sample through the desk's existing fetch path (acquire_datasets._fetch behind asia_collector._robots_allows, never a new scraper) into a Vintage and a LineageRecord, records dataset_request discoveries carrying the contract and the expected value in data/intelligence/data_acquisition_scientist/, opens the acquisition tasks in the registry (discoveries, dataset sources, and the scout swarm's source-hunt queue as status=candidate rows for crawlable URLs), re-requests only when the value moves or a day turns, and records DELAYED SOURCE ROI: for every dataset ever requested, whether a held mark now answers it, the delay from first request and the source-yield posteriors of what it then produced.

items.item: THE LOOP LIVENESS PROVER: every organ in the research loop reports on ITSELF, so the loop can break at one arrow while fifty-odd reports stay individually truthful and nothing names WHICH arrow. loop_liveness proves the ten arrows -- sources -> discoveries -> conversion (conversion debt) -> compiled cells -> the sealed judge's TEN GATES -> certificates -> forward-clock enrolment -> accrual -> promoter -> allocator -- from the canonical registry (ROOT data/alpha_registry.sqlite, opened READ-ONLY so the prover never creates what it measures) and from each organ's own artifact, publishing per stage the count in the last hour and in 24h, the age of the newest row, the age of the OLDEST UNPROCESSED input, and ALIVE / SLOW / STALLED / UNMEASURED with the owning organ and its last costed run. A stage with INPUT WAITING AND NO OUTPUT inside two cadences is STALLED and is published as a DEFECT; a stage idle for want of input is SLOW, because the defect is upstream and is named there. Gate names come from gate_policy.GATES and verdicts from the gate ledger the sealed judge writes -- external_gauntlet is read, never re-implemented and never edited. MEASURED FIRST RUN 2026-09-23 on VMI3500897: 3 ALIVE, 3 SLOW, 2 STALLED, 2 UNMEASURED, first stalled stage ten_gates_judged with 4,082 queued cells waiting on external_gauntlet against a newest verdict 154 h old

items.item: THE ANTI-STALENESS FENCE (principal 2026-09-22, make sure nothing is stale): the desk publishes ~300 artifacts from ~1,200 components and nothing read the whole set and asked whether it is still true. check_no_staleness derives every artifact's expected refresh interval in a declared order -- the artifact's own LEASE, else the component registry's artifact_class through lease.TTL_BY_CLASS, else DERIVED as two cadences of the organ's clock and RECORDED in the report's derived_expectations, else UNMEASURED, which is listed and counted and never a pass -- then fails with every artifact past its expectation, naming the organ, its clock and its last exit. REPAIRS ARE RAISED THROUGH THE RECONCILER THAT ALREADY EXISTS (the principal's stop adding independent fixers): observe then plan then apply_plan on libs/ops/control_plane/reconciler.py, which already treats an expired output lease as STALE and STALE as a BROKEN_STATE. The fence holds no repair logic and restarts nothing itself. MEASURED FIRST RUN 2026-09-23 on VMI3500897: 292 owned artifacts -- 43 FRESH, 100 STALE, 149 MISSING, 0 UNMEASURED; the reconciler judged 97 of the stale owners DEGRADED (unwired, which a restart cannot repair) and planned actuators for the 2 it judged STALE

items.item: FACTOR x MODEL CO-EVOLUTION AS A FIRST-CLASS ORGAN: separate populations of factors and of models, (F_i, M_j) pairings scored on the same folds, which factors work with which model CLASSES learned and published, and BOTH sides mutated from the residual error. Four islands breed feature subsets against model families; after each generation the champion's out-of-sample residual is interrogated and its structure mutates the FACTOR side (a session-structured residual pushes an hour feature into the set, a state-structured one a volatility feature) AND the MODEL side (a structured residual under a linear family promotes its nonlinear challenger). MEASURED 2026-09-22 on the box: 6 book instruments, 73 bred pairings plus 139 island pairings, 4 islands, 5 migrations, 2 survivors, 4,140 residual rows pooled
items.consumer: desks/mt5/research/deepening_worker.py through the research queue (model_pairing and the seven typed request kinds); libs/moat/registry.py research_candidates for every survivor that clears self-play

items.item: RESIDUAL-DRIVEN RESEARCH: after each model the residual series becomes a NEW RESEARCH DATASET. The champion's out-of-sample residuals are pooled across the swept instruments and asked what explains their structure by state, session, country, macro, participant, asset and horizon; an axis with no label column is UNMEASURED on that pass, never reported flat. Every structured axis automatically raises a typed request -- factor for state/session, data for country/macro/participant, representation for horizon, mechanism for asset -- into the queue the desk's deepening worker already reads. MEASURED 2026-09-22: 4,140 residual rows pooled, five structured axes (session, country, macro, participant, asset)
items.consumer: desks/mt5/research/deepening_worker.py (the merged research queue rows carry queue, priority and request_id); the residual_research block of COEVOLUTION.json

items.item: MODEL-FAMILY SEARCH AS ITS OWN CIVILIZATION: ten families -- linear, sparse, tree, boosting, neural, state-space, Bayesian, sequence, graph, mixture-of-experts -- each carrying a factor's discipline: lineage (a declared parent family), a novelty key so nothing is re-tested under a new name, a falsifier (its declared tax in nats per prediction, which its out-of-sample gain must clear) and a verdict allowed to be UNMEASURED. EVERY heavy library is a guarded optional accelerator and every family has a pure-Python fallback that always runs. THE GUARD IS NOT IMPORTABILITY BUT RETURN: measured on the box, sklearn imports in 6.7 s and HistGradientBoostingClassifier.fit on a 700x4 matrix never returns, so a probe subprocess fits each heavy-backed family and a family still marked started is served by the fallback with heavy_verdict UNMEASURED -- and the same health reading decides which zoo models the co-evolution organ asks for. MEASURED first run: 180 (R x M) cells, 6 earning, 5/10 families with an UNMEASURED heavy backend
items.consumer: libs/moat/registry.py research_candidates (each earning cell enqueued as a conditioning_model with its family lineage and novelty key); desks/mt5/research/factor_model_coevolution.py reads the same health map to choose which zoo models to run

items.item: REPRESENTATION x MODEL COMPATIBILITY SEARCH: a representation is NEVER declared dead after one learner. Six coordinate systems over the same bars and the same target -- raw, z-scored, ranked, volatility-scaled, range/state and path-shape -- are crossed with the ten model families and the whole grid is published as a matrix. A representation is DEAD only when every learner tried on it failed; with fewer than two learners its verdict is UNMEASURED. The same (R, M) key seen on several instruments keeps its BEST cell, not its last -- the bug that made every representation read DEAD while six earning cells sat in the winners list
items.consumer: the compatibility_matrix and representation_verdicts blocks of MODEL_SEARCH.json and COEVOLUTION.json; a DEAD representation stops being generated, an UNMEASURED one raises its own learner request

items.item: FAILURE TO STRUCTURED NEXT ACTION, AUTOMATIC: every failure emits the descendant its KIND implies. weak IC -> a representation change; state-dependent failure -> a conditional model; cost-dead (gross edge survives, net does not) -> lower-turnover descendants; model misspecification (a structured residual) -> a model-family challenger PLUS a falsification request so the challenger cannot quietly become champion; unmeasurable -> a data request. The classification is read off the numbers the fit already produced, in the desk's own order, and a dead cell that emits nothing is itself the defect. MEASURED 2026-09-22: 81 descendants queued from one co-evolution pass, 174 from one model-family sweep
items.consumer: desks/mt5/research/deepening_worker.py through the research queue; the queues block of both artifacts names every descendant kind and its parent

items.item: ACTIVE EXPERIMENT DESIGN: when two hypotheses compete the desk runs the experiment that maximises expected information gain about WHICH is true, not both blindly. The two leading islands' disagreement is scored per candidate design in expected bits per second -- a design both theories predict identically is worth zero bits however precisely it is measured -- the winner is queued as a falsification request, and the designs not run are counted as trials saved. The prior over which island holds is read from libs/research/research_priors.py when it is reachable and recorded AS uninformative when it is not
items.consumer: the active_design block of COEVOLUTION.json; the chosen design is pushed to the falsification queue and reaches the deepening worker

items.item: TRULY 24/7 QUEUES: seven INDEPENDENT queues -- data, factor, representation, model, mechanism, falsification and replication -- so a starved model queue is visible AS a starved model queue rather than hidden inside one pooled backlog that looks busy. Requests are de-duplicated by content hash, carry a priority, and idle capacity with high-value queued work is reported as a DEFECT with the queues that hold the work named. MEASURED 2026-09-22: one co-evolution pass left {data 3, factor 2, model 48, mechanism 1, falsification 27} with every slot in use
items.consumer: the queues block of COEVOLUTION.json and MODEL_SEARCH.json; every request is merged into the desk's research queue for the deepening worker

items.item: MULTI-ISLAND POPULATIONS: four independent islands with DIFFERENT priors over how the world is shaped (linear, nonlinear, state-conditional, sparse) and DIFFERENT slices of the feature vocabulary, evolving apart. Migration moves ONLY strong concepts: a positive net gain that is strictly better than the destination island's own best, capped per island, so migration cannot homogenise the archipelago into one population with extra bookkeeping. A concept that survives on two islands survived on two information sets. MEASURED 2026-09-22: 4 islands, 139 pairings, 5 migrations
items.consumer: the islands and migrations blocks of COEVOLUTION.json; a migrated concept seeds the destination island's next generation

items.item: RESEARCH SELF-PLAY: four roles on one claim -- proposer, attacker (the candidate's own fold-to-fold spread against its gain), independent re-implementer (a rebuild that disagrees is fatal) and SIMPLIFIER. A candidate must beat the strongest SIMPLER explanation, not only the null: it must clear the best lower-complexity rival by a complexity price per extra parameter, so structure is never free. A rejected champion does not vanish -- it emits its descendants. A role with no evidence records UNMEASURED rather than being credited as a pass
items.consumer: desks/mt5/research/factor_model_coevolution.py:542 -- only a champion whose verdict is SURVIVES_SELF_PLAY is written to the registry, and its roles ride along as lineage on the candidate

items.item: SYNTHETIC-WORLD BENCHMARK, CONTINUOUS: six worlds with structures the desk PLANTS itself -- additive, interaction, threshold, state-dependent, lagged, and a NULL control with nothing planted -- and the rediscovery score per research method is re-measured every co-evolution pass. The score is structured worlds rediscovered over structured worlds planted; a positive verdict on the null world is a FALSE POSITIVE published beside the score and never netted into it, so a method that fires on everything cannot look perfect. A desk that cannot rediscover a structure it planted has no standing to claim one it did not. MEASURED 2026-09-22: desk score 0.5 across the ten families
items.consumer: the synthetic_world block of COEVOLUTION.json -- per-method score, per-world hit and the null world's false positives; a method scoring zero is a research-method defect, not a market finding

items.item: NET IS THE CURRENCY, ONE FUNCTION: net = gross - spread/slippage at the cell's own size and state - market impact at that size - financing and swap over the holding period - commission - the multiplicity charge already owed. `libs/research/net_edge.py` returns the net figure, the full decomposition and an UNMEASURED verdict PER TERM the data cannot support. An unpriced term is never a zero: it makes the net a BOUND, and because four of the five terms can only reduce the edge while financing alone may be a credit, a negative bound with financing unpriced is COST_DEAD_UNCONFIRMED and not COST_DEAD. MEASURED 2026-09-23 on the real tree: 273 rows priced, 23 sign flips after costs (14 COST_DEAD, 9 unconfirmed), 55 net-positive.
items.consumer: desks/mt5/research/net_edge_spine.py is the only caller that writes; the three doors below all read its two artifacts

items.item: THE THREE DOORS RANK ON NET, NOT ON GROSS. (a) INTAKE: `miner_candidate_compiler` reads data/net_edge_ranks.json, orders its compiled candidates by net and stamps a sign-flipped cell COST_DEAD WITH ITS DECOMPOSITION instead of dropping it; the spine donates that cell's lower-turnover descendant through the `net_edge` seat, which is the `cost_dead -> lower_turnover_descendant` route libs/research/coevolution_lab.py already declares. (b) FORWARD SLOT: `forward_slot_ranker.net_of_cost` publishes net_over_gross and net_slot_value beside slot_value -- never overwriting it -- so the scarcest thing the desk owns goes to the highest NET expected E[log W]; MEASURED 2026-09-23: 35 clocks priced, 3 COST_DEAD. (c) ALLOCATOR: allocator_evidence gains a `net_of_cost` TermSpec plus net_capacity_rows, so the book sizes on net and on what it can actually carry; 214 sleeves priced, factors in [0.5, 1.6], heat-neutral.
items.consumer: miner_candidate_compiler (hypotheses ordered by net, net_ranking block), forward_slot_ranker (net_of_cost block in FORWARD_SLOT_RANKER.json), financing_lab -> data/allocator_evidence.json (net_of_cost term per sleeve)

items.item: NET ATTRIBUTION BACKWARD, AND THE REFUSAL IS BILLED. Every closed live trade in COUNTERFACTUAL_ATTRIBUTION.json (consumed, never edited) is scored against what this cost model PREDICTED for its cell, so the model that prices the book is itself priced -- bias, MAE, t and a CALIBRATED / OVER_CHARGING / UNDER_CHARGING verdict; a trade no priced row joins is UNMEASURED with the reason and never a silent pass. MEASURED 2026-09-23: 151 closed trades scored, verdict CALIBRATED, bias +0.0709R. Under GROWTH GOVERNANCE every COST_DEAD refusal carries a missed_growth_line in forward log-wealth, and `reweight_preserving_heat` returns a book with exactly the heat it was given: heat 0.224999 -> 0.224999 on the real tree, preserved to 1e-9. Nothing here vetoes, caps, shrinks or sizes.

items.item: THE PROPOSER SEAT (principal 2026-09-23, scope widened the same day to EVERY research process, not only the factories): an OPTIONAL external-model prior that proposes CANDIDATES and NAMES and can never produce a verdict. ONE shared entry point -- proposer_seat.ask(organ, kind, ...) with kinds order / names / terms / candidates -- so a new organ gets the seat by calling one function, and every organ that has called it is listed in the artifact with its counts, which is what makes 'is it everywhere' a measurement instead of a claim. Wired into the four factories (expression_factory skeletons into the invention stage, math_lab and physics_lab mechanism names on uninterpreted objects and cards, factor_model_coevolution and model_search as an ORDER hint over the factory's own option list), the mechanism_naming_queue, the crawlers and the deep forest, the sandbox runner, archaeology, the understanding seat, the residual hunt, the data-acquisition scientist and the meta curriculum. THE HARD RULES ARE TESTS, NOT INTENTIONS: a verdict field in a reply is stripped and the strip recorded, a verdict asserted in prose is discarded, an invalid proposal is discarded with its reason, every accepted proposal carries provenance (seat, model, prompt hash, timestamp) and is charged effective trials through libs/research/trial_ledger.py, the prompt builder reads no file and every composed prompt is scanned for the sealed holdout, PIT-future language and credential material, an order hint may reorder and may never widen, and a proposed term is a SEARCH STRING that still has to pass the organ's own source registry -- it can never become a new ground by being named. With no panel every consumer runs EXACTLY as it does today and the report reads UNMEASURED. SEVENTEEN organs are registered and each names itself to the seat: the six factories, forest_runner, seed_miners, world_crawler, deep_forest_miner, sandbox_runner, archaeology, understanding_seat, residual_hunt, data_acquisition_scientist, meta_controller and standing_questions. MEASURED 2026-09-23 on this build box: llm_seat resolves 0 seats (the panel file holds 24 providers with empty keys), the leg wrote PROPOSER_SEAT.json with verdict UNMEASURED and all 17 registered organs UNMEASURED -- which is the designed absent path, and the artifact's organ census is what makes the absence readable.

items.item: THE DARK SEATS, DIAGNOSED AND CLOSED (principal 2026-09-23). Measured on the trading box: deepseek donating hourly while kimi was 240h stale and fxmerge, mql5_catalog and mql5_prospector 281h stale. The causes were NOT the same and nothing said so. kimi: scripts/kimi_hunter.py's only clock was the VPS unit quant-kimi-hunter.timer, so the box that holds the credentials ran it never -- it now has an hourly leg (kimi_hunt). The other three: NO ORGAN AND NO CLOCK ANYWHERE IN THE TREE -- the name appears only in check_producer_yield's replacement table and source_registry's vocabulary, and the directories hold one-shot crawl output from 2026-08-26 and 2026-08-27. They are retired with a reason and a live named inheritor (fxblue, mql5_signals, mql5_survivors). The fence that makes this un-repeatable is scripts/check_seat_health.py: every configured seat with its clock, its cadence and its last donation age; OVERDUE past three cadences, UNMEASURED when nothing schedules it (never a silent pass), UNMEASURED_HERE when its clock belongs to the other host, UNMEASURED when its organ needs a credential this host does not hold, RETIRED when the retirement ledger says so. The inherited debt is DECLARED by seat name in BASELINE_OVERDUE and may only shrink, so a NEWLY dark seat fails the law gate immediately. MEASURED first run 2026-09-23: 92 seats -> 83 UNMEASURED, 5 OVERDUE (all five declared), 3 RETIRED, 1 UNMEASURED_HERE.

items.item: THE RECOMMENDATION LEDGER COULD NOT BE WRITTEN FROM THE BOX THAT TRADES (measured 2026-09-23). docs/research/recommendation_ledger.json held 777 rows, 219 of them OPEN, and had not moved for 281.7 hours while the CEO docket ran daily and wrote CEO_DOCKET.json beside it. TWO CAUSES, both real. (1) scripts/recommendations.py's read-modify-write lock did `import fcntl`, which is POSIX-only: every MUTATING subcommand (add / dispose / correct / repoint / claim) died with ModuleNotFoundError on Windows while `report` and `verify`, which skip the lock, worked perfectly, so the ledger looked healthy from the box and was physically unwritable there. `_flock_exclusive` now takes the same exclusive, non-blocking, closed-on-exit lock through msvcrt where fcntl is absent. (2) The only drain on any clock was ops/run_recommendation_worker.sh, a VPS cron that hands the open rows to an LLM; the VPS has published no commit since 2026-09-08, so the queue's only consumer had stopped and nothing said so.

items.item: THE IMPLEMENTER: the recommendation lane now DRAINS on a clock, deterministically and with no LLM in the path (principal 2026-09-23). Every pass takes the OPEN rows in priority order (a MEASURED roi_bps outranks a rank ordinal, age breaks every tie) and drives each to a recorded outcome: IMPLEMENTED only when the row's deliverable is a file that did not exist at the ask and git says it was ADDED more than a grace window later, cited by that add-commit; SCHEDULED only when the row waits on an artifact a clocked organ regenerates, with that clock named and its next firing as the due date; REJECTED for the standing order against reducing aggressiveness, retired crypto-exchange ground, or a duplicate of a NAMED terminal row; otherwise BLOCKED with an exactly named blocker, an owner and a next action. BLOCKED IS NOT A FIFTH STATUS: the row stays `open` and visible to check_conversion, check_row_atomicity, ledger_reversion and owed(), and gains owner / next_action / blocker instead, because a new status word no existing fence knows would be a better hiding place than `scheduled` ever was. Where a row asks for code it opens a build task (deterministic BT id) rather than writing speculative code. MEASURED FIRST PASS: 219 OPEN -> 216, 226 rows moved (3 implemented, 6 rejected, 1 scheduled, 216 blocked-with-owner), 0 open rows without an owner, largest blocker class needs_specification at 104.

items.item: THE RECOMMENDATION-FLOW FENCE, AND THE LOOP CLOSED BACK TO THE CEO. Three fences already read this ledger -- check_conversion, check_citation_integrity, check_row_atomicity -- and all three were green through 281.7 hours of it not being written at all, because a queue that has STOPPED and a queue that is caught up look identical to a rate. check_recommendation_flow fails on three properties instead: the ledger past its own cadence (state half, --require-state, so a fresh clone is not graded on its last commit's age), any OPEN row with no owner or no next action (portable and fatal), and the OPEN count above its ratchet floor with nothing recorded to explain the rise -- the backlog ratchets DOWN only, and a rise is legal exactly when the pass NAMES what raised it. The loop closes the other way too: intake pulls the CEO docket's undecided proposals and the frontier audit's findings into THIS ledger rather than a second store (absent sources named UNMEASURED, never skipped), and frontier_ceo asks already_settled() before proposing, so a recommendation the desk has implemented or reasoned its way out of is listed as settled instead of arriving again as new work.

items.item: THE CONVERSION MAXIMISER (principal 2026-09-23, "permanently maximise 100 percent conversion to testable cells of all minings ... we always squeeze the life out of everything we get and have"). MEASURED ON THE TRADING BOX THAT DAY: 66,898 discoveries of which 31,226 BLOCKED and 2,843 never processed; 305,265 research candidates of which 234,996 sat in status donated having never been offered to a judge; 31 survivors. discovery_compiler converts what ARRIVES and experiment_spine converts what the compilers' ARTIFACTS carry -- nothing attacked the residue already inside the registry. This organ does: it classifies every non-converted row in the compilers' own CompileDefect vocabulary (PROSE_ONLY / NO_INSTRUMENT / NO_FAMILY / NO_FALSIFIER / NO_DATA / OFF_UNIVERSE / UNREADABLE), publishes the histogram with the organ that OWNS each class plus the per-class count, repair rate and MEDIAN AGE, and then ACTS: the standing re-judgement falsifier, a family bound through axis_registry.FAMILY_TABLE, the instrument resolved through the MT5 universe registry in the hypothesis lane only, and BARS SUPPLIED rather than demanded (ensure_bars: a chart coarser than one the desk holds is built by exact OHLCV aggregation and written; a finer one cannot be manufactured so the cell is bound to the finest series held and the fetch is requested). Repairs are re-enqueued through registry.enqueue_candidate with provenance edges and EFFECTIVE trials charged (participation ratio, not raw count). Conversions are ordered by the EFFECTIVE BREADTH they add, so the backlog drains toward independent cells. NOTHING IS PARKED: a row this pass could not repair stays QUEUED carrying its blocker and its owner, the pass's leftover is the FIRST work of the next pass, and the oldest waiting row's age is published every pass. The only permanent refusals are OFF_UNIVERSE (the 2026-08-18 universe mandate) and EVENT_LANE (the 2026-09-06 two-lane law); a licence, robots directive or access label is provenance metadata and NEVER a blocker (principal 2026-09-23). MEASURED FIRST THREE PASSES on VMI3500897: conversion debt 5,583 -> 1,483 (-73.4%), 4,100 rows repaired, 0 refused, 0 silently dropped, effective breadth 42.44 -> 47.40

items.item: THE CONVERSION-DEBT RATCHET (principal 2026-09-23, the harsh rule). A mined row that is neither a gauntlet cell nor a recorded, reasoned refusal is a DEFECT WITH AN OWNER, and the count of them is CONVERSION DEBT. The desk's coverage floors ratchet UP (L1.50); debt is the same quantity with the sign flipped, so it ratchets DOWN. The ceiling is seeded from the measured debt and may only fall -- and it CANNOT BE RAISED BY HAND, because the enforced ceiling is min(ceiling, lowest_ever), so an edit that raises either number is inert. There is no --force and no environment override: the only way past this gate is to convert the rows. A machine with no registry reports UNMEASURED at rc 1, which is a real answer and never a pass (L1.28a), which is why it is a STATE fence beside check_ingestion_exploitation. SEEDED 2026-09-23 on VMI3500897 at 1,483 after the first three passes took the debt down from 5,583

items.item: THE PLUMBING WATCHDOG (principal 2026-09-23: "make the plumbing never ever permanently stop silently"). Every fifteen minutes on the box and every hour in the cycle, seven checks that PROVE BY OBSERVATION rather than by a label: the adoption task is present, Enabled, has a next run inside the hour and did not last exit an error; HEAD descends from the branch tip it should have adopted and the shortfall is counted in commits; the git-writer lock is TAKEN and released right now; no orphaned pool worker holds commit and headroom is above a floor DERIVED from this host's measured commit limit; every task the installer declares is present and Enabled; every producer/consumer pair in libs/ops/control_plane/edges.py agrees about its path; every fence registered in run_law_gate has actually run. Anything false is a DEFECT ROW carrying the organ, the evidence and the repair. MEASURED on its first pass 2026-09-23: 36 defects -- MT5-AdoptRelease Disabled with last result 267014, HEAD 232 commits behind origin/claude/llm-auto-upgrade-verify-gcjac3, 27 declared tasks Disabled, 9 registered fences absent from the last battery, 4 broken pipeline edges.

items.item: SILENCE IS IMPOSSIBLE: a plumbing defect that survives one pass escalates to three surfaces a human meets WITHOUT ASKING -- the desk state the dashboard renders, a PLUMBING_DEFECT row in the event log, and docs/research/PLUMBING_ALERTS.md -- and the law gate REFUSES TO PASS while any defect is older than its own per-check escalation window (adoption 3h, lock/orphans/commit 2h, paths/fences 24h). The absence of the watchdog's report is itself such a defect, because a watchdog that stopped reports no defects for the same reason it reports nothing at all. Every failure this closes was ALREADY being logged correctly, once an hour, to a file nobody read.

Tests now read the SOURCE and fail if: the launchers stop spawning through libs/ops/proctree.run; the orphan reaper stops running FIRST in the reconciler's apply pass; the adoption task stops being daily-repeating-hourly under SYSTEM; any of the four git writers stops dot-sourcing GitWriterMutex.ps1 and taking MT5-GitWriter-v2; or the live sleeve policy stops banning FX and M15 at both doors.

items.item: THE 24/7 MAXIMISER (principal 2026-09-23). Every hour it measures the desk's four standing bottlenecks -- conversion debt, judging throughput in hours-of-queue at the measured rate, forward enrolment latency, and plumbing defects -- names the single BINDING one on a common saturating severity, and moves compute toward it through the budget machinery that already exists: `research_auction.build` blends this organ's compute_shift with bottleneck_law's by MAXIMUM, and the auction's factors are what `research_budget.budget_s` multiplies. Plumbing past its escalation window scores 1.0 and binds outright, because every other measurement is then a measurement of a stopped machine. Every shift is >= 1.0: the organ has no instrument for starving a department (growth governance Rule 2). The trend of all four over the last day is published, so 'is it getting better' is answerable every morning. MEASURED first pass 2026-09-23: BINDING = plumbing_defects at severity 0.78, meta raised to x1.783.

items.item: JUDGING THROUGHPUT TO THE MAXIMUM THE BOX CAN HOLD (principal 2026-09-23: "we have tons of headroom in our box to increase judging -- give it tons of headroom possible for maximum throughput"). external_gauntlet.py is SEALED and is never edited; its _worker_count() and _measured_budget_mb() already honour GAUNTLET_WORKERS, GAUNTLET_MEMORY_BUDGET_MB, GAUNTLET_HEADROOM_CAP_MB and GAUNTLET_PER_WORKER_MB from the environment, so the judge is sized from OUTSIDE it. WHAT BOUND IT, measured off the gauntlet's own artifact rather than argued: the sealed budget is max(declared_need, min(0.5 x free, HEADROOM_CAP_MB=8192)), and at PER_WORKER_MB=768 that ceiling alone caps the judge at TEN workers however large the box is -- a ceiling sized for an 8 GB machine and never re-derived when the judge moved to a 98 GB one. The last published sweep ran workers=1 with memory_budget_mb=1984 against 21,391 cells discovered, 1,395 judged and 3,490 deferred on the build budget: a measured queue depth of 19,996 at 101.583 gates/hour. THREE RAILS AND NONE IS A BRAKE: the plan is FLOORED at the sealed baseline so the organ can never throttle the judge; the live terminal always wins and standing down means RETURNING to that floor, never below it; and every number is measured on the machine the code runs on, so a build box writes an EMPTY env rather than handing the 18-core judge its own 4-core figure

items.item: NO SCARCITY ON FORWARD EVIDENCE, EVER (principal 2026-09-23: "make all certis always receive immediate clocks at the same time when certified; and remove the slots being scarce by design permanently ... no quota or scarcity ever on forward evidence slots"). A forward clock GATHERS EVIDENCE AND DEPLOYS NO CAPITAL -- shadow_forward replays a certified recipe against bars the desk already holds and writes an R series; promotion to LIVE is a separate, certificate-gated act by the sealed promoter. So a cap on ENROLMENT bought no safety at all and cost only hypotheses the desk could never rule on. REMOVED: forward_reconcile.family_budget no longer declares itself an enrolment cap (decides = NOTHING__ENROLMENT_IS_UNCAPPED, gates_enrolment False); its per-family alpha arithmetic stays, published as EVIDENCE that gates nothing. KEPT EXACTLY AS IT WAS: multiplicity, the Holm/BH cohort, the deflated-Sharpe charge and the effective-trial ledger -- more clocks make every clock's bar HARDER, automatically, and that price is paid in full. The immutable floor is never a knob; what was removed is the SLOT QUOTA, not the statistics. forward_slot_ranker.py stays as a REPORT of order and priority and gates nothing, as its own docstring already said

items.item: THE SANDBOX SUPPLY LINE (LAWS 5h/5m). Measured 2026-09-23: the runner planned 63 federated systems and could run 7 -- 55 read UNMEASURED because their pinned library was not importable, each carrying an INSTALL TASK row that no organ ever executed. "Recorded as a task" is not a disposition; it is a defect with a to-do list (LAWS 7). sandbox_provision.py IS the organ that executes them: ONE shared venv at <sandbox root>/_shared/venv built with --system-site-packages over the desk's own interpreter (per-system venvs would each re-install the scientific core, ~500 MB apiece against MEASURED free disk, so the line would stop on disk long before it stopped on capability, and the gateway's interpreter is never mutated), ROI order (measured ROI, then declared yield -- candidates and datasets outrank a representation -- then light before heavy), one pinned requirement at a time, the module PROVED to import, and the licence read at the same pin the wheel came from. pip's own words classify the failure: no matching distribution, a Requires-Python this interpreter fails, a resolution conflict, or a source build needing a C toolchain are PERMANENTLY_UNAVAILABLE -- written once with the exact error and the cover that carries the capability, and NEVER retried, because retrying an interpreter incompatibility hourly forever is a lie about effort. Everything else is RETRYABLE on a 30-minute doubling backoff to a week. The ledger is written after EVERY attempt so a killed pass forgets nothing

items.item: SANDBOX ROTATION AND MEASURED BREADTH (LAWS 5h, L1.32). The runner allocated the hour ROI-proportionally over everything it could run, which is a ratchet: the systems that produced kept producing and a system that had never run could wait forever without anybody deciding it should -- a frontier switched off by arithmetic rather than by evidence. TWO LANES now. SCOUT: the most OVERDUE runnable systems get a floor share FIRST, ordered by age ALONE with no ROI test and no breadth test in it, enough slots that the whole roster fits inside a 24h window, never more than half the pass; a system that has never run is infinitely overdue and is therefore always a scout, and the proposer seat may reorder the exploit lane but the scouts are pinned back to the front afterwards. EXPLOIT: the rest is ROI-proportional REWEIGHTED by MEASURED marginal breadth -- each system's donated (family|symbol|horizon) cells are one row of an indicator matrix and libs.risk.fx_exposure.effective_rank (the participation ratio of its singular-value spectrum, the same arithmetic the book uses for n_effective) says how many independent directions the federation spans; a system's marginal breadth is the DROP when its row is removed, so a system that re-donates a crowded corner reads ~0 and the sole holder of a direction reads a whole one. This adds compute to the orthogonal systems; it takes the hour from nobody -- the floor is what stops that

items.item: THE SANDBOX LIVENESS FENCE (LAWS 5h, L1.28c, L1.32): a runnable federated system that has not run inside its rotation window (x1.5 grace, so one skipped pass is not a breach) FAILS the law gate by name and age; and an UNMEASURED reason that is byte-identical for seven days FAILS unless the install ledger shows the task moving -- an attempt inside the week, or a settled PERMANENTLY_UNAVAILABLE row that names its exact error AND the cover that carries its capability. items.item: THREE ZERO-PRODUCTION BINDINGS FIXED, each with its measured cause (LAWS 5h, RESEARCH 10). (2) numerai_method declares yields=(research_methods, candidates) and donated no candidate at all: every per-era out-of-sample rank correlation it measured stayed a research-method row that no gate ever judged. Each model's measured correlation against the 24-bar forward return is now donated as a hypothesis, family chosen by the SIGN (positive -> trend_ma_cross, negative -> mean_reversion_rsi, because a consistently negative correlation is mean reversion and not a null), with the gauntlet judging. items.item: THE THREE COST DEFECTS COST_TRUTH NAMED ARE FIXED, each with a test that pins the corrected arithmetic. (1) net_edge_spine.commission_term derived commission/spread as zero/(raw-zero), but fusion_cost.COST_REGIMES is a table of SPREAD MULTIPLIERS and RAW is 0.2 -- so raw-zero is one FIFTH of the spread and commission, ~98% of this account's charged cost, was billed at 5x. It now carries the multiplier, read from the table rather than copied. (2) COMMISSION_PER_LOT_PER_SIDE was the brochure's USD 2.25 fed to a field Costs.from_symbol converts as ACCOUNT currency; the account pays 2.00 flat in EUR on all 433 deals it has ever done. It is now 2.00 with COMMISSION_UNIT naming the unit, and the five mirrors, the engine default and check_cost_construction's ceiling moved with it. (3) cost_surface.py wrote COST_SURFACE.json while the spine read EXECUTION_COST_SURFACE.json: one writer and one reader per path now, both declared as edges the plumbing watchdog checks. cost_surface's own cost_r was ALSO dividing by live_ledger.risk_quote -- 85 of its 151 priced deals carry a risk_quote disagreeing with their own stop distance by more than 10x -- and now divides by the stop distance through tick_value. WHAT IT HOLDS was 241 rows in the registry's `sources` table; WHAT IT COULD LAWFULLY HOLD was every root its forty-odd country packs declare, every ground in deep_forest_sources.json and every row in source_registry.json -- and none of those had ever been written where the crawlers look. `loop_liveness` called the whole `sources_ingested` stage STALLED (148 uncrawled, oldest waiting 134 hours) and nothing owned the number. This organ owns it: it SEEDS every lawful ground into the registry, RESOLVES the 60 rows the evidence router minted with no url against the registered grounds' own hosts, REFUSES only the principal's five ACTS, crawls the rest through the existing `moat_collectors` machinery, and publishes the day's single largest information gap by expected value. MEASURED over its first two live passes: lawful grounds known 0 -> 1,626; OVERDUE backlog 123 -> 63 -> 0; oldest wait 134.7h -> 6.0h; 95 grounds crawled in the second pass alone. The fence ratchets the overdue backlog and the oldest wait DOWN and the cumulative drained count UP; the headline uncrawled count may rise ONLY in a pass that registered new lawful ground, because seeding what the registry had never heard of is the organ's first duty and a fence that punished it would teach the next session to stop seeding.

items.item: THE TEN SOURCE LAYERS ARE MEASURED FROM THE OUTSIDE, NOT DECLARED BY THE PACK. Every pack writes `verified: False` into its own source rows and always will -- a pack has no way of knowing whether anything ever fetched the root it named -- so `coverage.covered()` read DECLARED_UNVERIFIED for almost every layer on the desk and the ten-layer depth claim was an assertion rather than a measurement. `coverage_drain.verify_layers` decides it from the registry instead: a layer is MAPPED when a row whose host matches one of that layer's declared roots carries a real `last_crawled` stamp, ABSENT_DECLARED when the pack named the layer absent with a reason, REFUSED_HARD_BOUNDARY when every declared host sits behind one of the five refused ACTS, DECLARED_UNVERIFIED when roots exist and none has been fetched, and UNMAPPED when the pack said nothing at all. Five states and no quiet zero. items.item: THE LAWFUL-GROUND PRE-FILTER IS DELETED; CLASSIFICATION NOW ROUTES USE AND NEVER STOPS MINING (principal's order 2026-09-23). LAWS 5e carried six brakes the desk had imposed on ITSELF, none of which was a legal requirement: an ACCESS_UNCLEAR QUARANTINE that kept a row's metadata and threw its claim away (allowed_uses = one entry, register, at evidence_weight_cap 0.0); a machine-extraction veto that stripped machine_extract and store_raw from every PUBLIC_WITH_TERMS row; a robots.txt Disallow read as that same refusal; machine_use_allowed=false read as 'registered, never scraped'; an eight-domain clone allowlist in the research sandbox; and a licence gate that refused to RUN public research code, which the module's own text called 'the single reason every seed is UNDISPOSED today'. Things published on the open internet are lawful to read. Licence, robots, source class and credibility are now ROUTING AND PROVENANCE LABELS -- they say what may be REDISTRIBUTED (redistribute_allowed, terms_note) and how much WEIGHT the evidence carries -- and they never stop discovery, ingestion, representation or testing. Every label but the refused three grants the full MINING_USES vocabulary at a non-zero cap; quarantine is False on every routing row and the ledger it fed is empty by construction. What remains is about ACTS, not content, and is exactly five (HARD_BOUNDARY, pinned by HARD_BOUNDARY_COUNT): no credential theft or logging in as someone else; no bypassing an access control or a paywall; no material non-public information; no stolen or leaked private data; no personal data harvesting or doxxing. A page behind a login or paywall is never broken into and its open surface is mined like any other. The six deleted brakes are named as DATA in REMOVED_BRAKES and in the law text, so a later session cannot re-derive the old caution from silence. ONE FIX WENT THE OTHER WAY, and it is the one that had to: the hard-boundary marker scan never read `claim`, the router's OWN primary content key, so a credential dump or an MNPI line arriving in the exact shape route() builds reached none of the marker scans and was labelled on its url alone. Widening the boundary's reach is the single direction that module may still move.

items.item: NOTHING IS QUEUED: THE QUEUE CENSUS AND ITS FENCE (principal's order 2026-09-23, 'keep no queues ... nothing should be queued in the research system, all immediate tested'). A row is processed ON ARRIVAL; where a budget genuinely runs out the leftover is the FIRST work of the next pass and its AGE IS PUBLISHED, never an indefinite park. The desk had no idea how much of its own work was parked, because each organ knew its own number, in its own unit, and no artifact put them side by side. queue_census.py measures every queue in the desk -- depth, the age of the OLDEST ROW, and a drain rate DIFFERENCED against the previous census rather than declared -- and check_no_queues.py fails when any queue's oldest row is older than ONE CYCLE of the organ that owns it, when a queue has open rows and NO DRAINER at all (PARKED), or when rows carry no enqueue timestamp so their age cannot be measured (UNMEASURED, which fails: L1.28a). It CONSUMES the artifacts other builders own -- CONVERSION_MAXIMISER.json, GAUNTLET_BACKPRESSURE.json, COVERAGE_DRAIN.json, FORWARD_ENROLMENT.json, QUEUE.json -- and never opens their stores or second-guesses their numbers. THE FIRST PASS SHIPS RED AND THE RED IS THE WORK: 14 queues, 63,110 rows waiting, 6 BREACH, 1 PARKED, 2 UNMEASURED, oldest row 654 h (27 days). research_queue.json holds 21,373 open rows with NO SCHEDULED DRAINER -- its only readers are report builders and an archive restorer that puts rows BACK. registry.claim_candidates(), the lease meant to drain 5,769 queued sqlite candidates, has zero callers outside registry.py. miner_deepening_queue.json holds 28,450 rows carrying no per-row timestamp, so their age was literally unknowable. A fence tuned to pass on today's backlog would pin that backlog in place (L1.43), so it is not tuned.

items.item: ONE CANON, RESTORED BY THE ORGAN ITSELF (principal 2026-09-23: 'everything remains empty -- open, close, all automatic, don't just report'; LAWS 7 A REPORT IS NOT A REMEDY). The certificate lane had TWO pens: the sealed gauntlet, and its unfixed fork desks/mt5/side_channels/ug_remote.py, wired as the hourly leg auto_ug_remote, which rewrote reports/UNIVERSAL_SURVIVORS.json from an empty dict with no gate_policy key. The canon went 56 -> 0 on 2026-09-17 and was still being re-emptied hourly six days later while 13 sleeves traded and 855 forward clocks ran. Losing the ATTESTATION was the worse half: every reader fell through to the seal, and the sealed gauntlet's own restore loop reads retired_certificates out of the file the wipe had just emptied, so it could restore nothing for ever. The fork now carries the same three guards its sealed twin got in 2026-08-25 (retain, attest, refuse empty, refuse shrink), and certificate_truth.repair() closes the damage on its OWN hourly clock with no --apply and no hand, through the lane's own rules only: the authority ratchet's seal restore (whose only clock is a VPS systemd timer, on the wrong machine), a git harvest for what a bad writer overwrote in place, and the sealed gauntlet's own restore predicate re-asking each retirement its own question. It can only ADD evidence the desk already earned: it never retires a row, never lowers a count, never touches sleeves.json or the gateway. And an EMPTY canon is now UNMEASURED, never 'nothing is certified' -- apply() withholds every retirement unless the lane is SETTLED, because the migration of 2026-09-23 08:37 retired 597 forward clocks and 73 ledger claims against an authority file a second writer had emptied.

status_vocabulary_note: LANDED means the code exists in THIS REPOSITORY, on a named clock, with an artifact and a consumer. It does NOT mean the artifact has ever been produced on the trading box, and it does not mean the behaviour has been observed with money at risk. That distinction is what the five acceptance_properties measure, and they are measured from artifacts rather than asserted: an absent artifact reads UNMEASURED, never MET. Read the census as build coverage and the acceptance properties as operational proof. They are different questions and the second is the one that decides whether the desk works.
